tei:div.tei:p: 271) ༄༅/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lo rgyus shel gyi me long snying po'i bcud phyung bzhugs so/

kun slong bcos nas gsang sngags rnying ma gter ma'i lo rgyus gyi mtshams sbyar nas/ 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ dus gsum kun mkhyen slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas mchim phu'i bre gu dge 'ur bzhugs pa la: mnga' bdag chen pos slob dpon la dar zab kyi khri brtsigs: spyang dkar gyis slog pa dang: za 'og smug ber sku la gsol: 'bras chang 'ding ma gser skyogs dang dngul skyogs bkang nas drangs : 'jig rten gyi spyan gzigs mang po phul: gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la rin po che sna tshogs kyi tshom bu bkod pa phul cing: lha phyag gyang 'gyel ba 'dra ba btsal: mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bstod de zhus pa: e ma ho: skye med kyi sku: 'gag med kyi gsung: 'khrul med kyi thugs: yon tan rin po che dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas: phrin las 'gro 'dul thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bdag nyid: yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsam 'phel ltar bka' lung rab 'byams 272) la theg pa chen po 'dzad med kyi gter khung rdol ba'i rje dam par gyur pa: skye 'chi dang bgres rgud mi mnga' zhing: nyes pa'i skyon mtha' dag dang bral nas: legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i o rgyan gyi 'gro mgon chen po lags: khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin la 'khor ba'i dus skabs ma mchis shing: sngon chad kyang theg pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi zab cing : chos kyi sgron me dpag tu med pa thugs la btags mod kyang: yang bdag cag rje blon 'khor 'bangs rnams dang: ma 'ongs snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi don du: theg pa phyi yi don 'dus pa: nang gis khong tshang ba: gsang ba'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs: yi dam rnams kyi dngos grub: mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi srog snying: dam can thams cad kyi phrin las: chos skyong thams cad kyi bla rdo: 'gag 'dril la don 'dus pa: kha tshang la lag len bde ba:

gab sbas med par zhal gsal ba: gsol ba btab na byin brlabs 'byung nges pa: 273) ༄༅/ bsgrubs na 'grub myur zhing zhe blo bde ba: bcangs ba tsam kyis grol ba: mtshan thos pa tsam gyis gus pa skye ba: phyogs su ma lhung ba: ris su ma chad pa: gang dang yang mthun pa: gzhan la ma ltos pa: go bde ba: mang nyung ran pa: thar pa'i lam: ngan song gi skye sgo gcod pa: nad thams cad kyi sman: gdon thams cad kyi srung ba: rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad kyi bzlog pa: dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams thams cad kyi gshed: 'byung ba dar gud thams cad kyi rtsis: mdor na gang zag blo rigs so sor gang la gang dgos: ci la ci 'dod thams cad tshang ba'i gdams pa: gzhan la ma brgyud pa: nyid kyi thugs kyi 'od zer las byung ba: dgongs pa'i mthil gtad pa: sngon chad ma byung zhing: phyin chad kyang mi 'byung ba lung gang dang yang mthun pa: sgra rang bsgyur: don dgongs bsgyur: man ngag gnad bsgyur: bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel: 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i dkar po gcig thub gcig: dus 'di 274)nyid du thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu: ces gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pas: mchi ma blags shing gsol ba btab ste zhus pa: kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru rin po che: dgyes pa'i bzhad 'dzum dang ldan pas dar gcig dgongs pa la bzhugs te: sku lus gzengs bstod 'od zer phyung: gsung tshangs pa'i mgur dbyangs gdangs bskyed: thugs dgongs pa rtse gcig rgyal po la gtad de gsungs pa: kyai mnga' bdag rgyal po: sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa: sku lus kyis bkod pa sprul bsgyur mdzad pa: gsung gis bkod pa bla na med pa'i chos su smra ba: thugs kyi bkod pa gzhan phan don du gnyer ba: yon tan kyi bkod pa dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs pa: phrin las kyi bkod pa 'gro ba thams cad theg pa chen po yang dag gi chos la 'god pa: chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' gsan mdzod cig:

khyed kyis zhus pa ni don dang ldan no: ngas smras pa ni rdo rje'i tshig go: yon mchod gnyis kyi bre mo ni 'gro ba la phan no: tshig ma nor zhing don yid la rab 275) ru zungs shig: phrin las 'gro 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas nga: lho nub o rgyan rgya mtsho gser gyi gling: rin chen chu ngogs pad+ma'i sdong po las: mngal gyis ma gos zo kha 'bru pad+ma'i steng: legs skyes rab brten snang ba mtha' yas bu: 'gro ba'i don phyir 'dzam bu gling du babs : thog mar skal bzang rgyal pos rgyal srid bzung: gzhan snang 'gro 'dul blo gros brtul pa'i phyir: bar du thos bsam slob dpon mang po bsten: chags thogs med par don gnyis bsgrub slad du: mtha' ma yo ga tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes: skye 'chi rgyun chad rdo rje'i sku ru gyur: phyi nang snang srid rang gi rig par shar: snod bcud 'khor 'das rang rig byang chub sems: sems kyis rtsal chen rang dbang rang gis thob: khams gsum yongs sgrol dug gsum rtsad nas bcad: srid gsum gtan sprugs rang rig rtsal chen rdzogs: mthu rtsal nus pa nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra: smon lam dbang gis bod khams 'dul don du: bsam yas mthil du rgyal pos spyan drangs nas: lha srin sde brgyad brdul du brlags nas ni: rgyal po'i thugs dam dpal gyis bsam yas bzhengs: rje blon thams cad dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir: dam chos bka' yi gram chen brdal nas kyang: 276) gang la gang dgos brdal bar bstan pa yin: da rung rje blon yab yum 'khor dang bcas: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug rnams kyi don slad du: theg pa'i gsang sgo rim gyis 'byed pa yin: khyad par yang zab don gyi mthar thug las: bcud du dril ba rgyal pos zhus pa legs: kun dang mthun zhing kun gyis snying po'i phul: 'brel tshad don ldan dgongs 'dus snying du 'chongs: gzhan las ma brgyud pad 'byung dgongs pa'i mthil: mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag gsang chen rgyal ba'i bka':

phur tshug nyams su len mdzod mnga' bdag rje: da lta'i dus 'dir spel ba'i gnas med kyis: dam tshig sor bzhag rin chen sgrom bur bcug: phyi rabs don du gsang mchog gter du sbos: 'di 'dra'i bka' gsang sngon chad bsgrags pa med: da yang mi sgrog 'dzam gling yongs la dkon: 'di nyid mthing shog dag la rin chen gyis: ma bu cha lag rdzogs par bris nas ni: 'gro ba gang gis lus la bcangs gyur na: o rgyan nga dang 'bral med 'grogs 'gyur zhing: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlob: yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs kyis dngos grub ster: 277) mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyi rtag tu srung: rigs drug sdug bsngal nyon mongs g.yang sa gcod: ci bsam don kun yid bzhin lhun 'grub 'byung: gcig chog blo bde dgongs pa'i mthar thug yin: chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dam mdzod: ye shes mtsho rgyal dkar chag yi ger bris: ces gsungs nas: nyid kyi thugs dam kyi gsang mdzod brdol nas: bla ma'i sgrub pa rgyud man ngag lag len las kha tshar dang bcas pa sngon chad kyang : sku sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa : gsung sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa: thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa: spyi 'dus 'khor lo: rigs 'dus 'khor lo: gtsug gi rgyan gcig: gtsug gi nor bu: rigs bdag bde ba chen po: sku gsum bde ba chen po: thugs sgrub 'od kyi drwa ba: bla ma yongs rdzogs: byin rlabs gter sgrom: ma gcig bu gcig: nor bu gcig pa: rab 'byams gsung sgron: bla ma srog tig: 278) rgya mtsho klong yangs: ri rab 'od 'phro: bla ma dgongs gcig: nyi zla 'bar ba: bla ma gsang ba gnad kyi me long: phra tig bkod pa: me tog brgyan pa: gsang ba'i snying po: bla ma bde mchog : yon tan bkod pa: bla ma 'gro 'dul: bla ma yang zhun gser gyi 'bru gcig: bla ma yid bzhin nor bu: yid bzhin 'khor lo: yid bzhin gter mdzod: bla ma spyi 'chings 'dus pa:

bla ma bka' brgyad 'dus pa: bla ma gsang chen rol ba: bla ma zhi ba 'dus pa: bla ma khro bo 'bar ba: bla ma drag po sgrub pa: bla ma zin tig gter sgrom: bla ma bcud kyi dum bu: bla ma shel kyi nyi 'od: bla ma dgos 'dod kun 'byung la sogs pa bla ma phyi nang gsang gsum dpag tu med pa phyi rabs kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi don du bshad cing: gang la gang 'dul kyi tshul du bstan pa rnams kyis nang nas bcud phyung zhing gnad dril ba don bsdus pa: gzhan yi dam zhi khro thams cad kyi rtsa ba: ma mo mkha' 'gro 279) ༄༅/ thams cad kyi srog tig: dam can chos skyong thams cad kyi rje dpon: bskyed rim thams cad kyi 'gag don: rdzogs rim thams cad kyi snying po: man ngag thams cad kyi yang zhun: byin rlabs thams cad kyi rtsa ba: dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas: nus mthu thams cad kyi dpung bskyed: bla ma thams cad kyi dgongs 'dus: 'di bsgrubs pas kun 'grub pa: 'di'i mtshan thos pa la sogs ste: 'di nyid kyi lung tshar gcig rna ba'i dbang po'i yul du 'grims pa tsam gyis: gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad thos zhing lung thob pa dang 'dra la: 'di'i dbang nod pa rnams ni: gsang sngags 'gyur ro cog gi dbang thob pa dang mtshungs shing: don yid la byed pa rnams ni: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin phyir mi ldog pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes dang ting nge 'dzin tshe 'di nyid la rten zhing thob par 'gyur zhing: gnas skabs tshe 'dir yang: mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyi mchod pa'i gnas: bkur sti'i zhing dam par 'gyur la: 280) nad dang gnod pa: rkyen dang bar chad la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad zhi ba dang: tshe dang: bsod nams: dpal dang: 'byor pa: grags pa dang snyan pa la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan ci bsam pa thams cad 'grub la dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur: khams gsum srid pa gsum kyi tshe dang bsod nams:

dpal 'byor snyan grags: skye 'gro pho mo zas nor longs spyod la sogs pa ci ltar 'dod pa thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus par 'gyur: rang gzhan thams cad dang: bstan pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i: sdang dgra gnod byed gdon bgegs: rkyen ngan bar chad 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa pha rol kyi rigs sngags: bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad tshar gcod cing bzlog par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i: rang rang so sor ci ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'byung ba'i yid bzhin kyi nor bu rin po che: theg pa phyi nang thams cad kyi don 'dus zhing khog tshang ba: gsang sngags bla na med pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa mngon du phyung ba: bla ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs: yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi dngos grub dang srog snying: dam can chos skyong thams cad 281) ༄༅/ kyi phrin las kyi bla rdo: bshad pa thams cad kyi don: sgrub pa thams cad kyi snying po: man ngag thams cad kyi rtsa ba: mnga' bdag nyid kyis ji ltar zhus pa: thams cad tshang ba'i gdams pa snying po gser gyi yang zhun: 'di dag mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid kyis g.yar dam du chongs shig: ces gsungs nas bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i gdams pa gser phur mnga' bdag rgyal po la gdams te: de nyid du mnga' bdag rgyal po la byin rlabs kyi ltas dpag tu med pa byung zhing bsgrubs pas: grub pa'i rtags bsam gyis mi byung: ma gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis yi ger bris pas kyang byin rlabs zhugs: nyams 'bar: bsgrubs pas mchog dang mthun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu brnyes zhing rtogs pa'i gding dang ldan par gyur nas ci 'dod kyi dngos grub kyang char bzhin du babs so: mtsho rgyal kyis yi ge tshar gnyis bris ste: gcig ni rgyal po'i thugs dam du bzhes: ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du mnga' bdag gi sku la bcangs shing: 282) dgongs pa gshegs nas kyang bka' rgya mang po mdzad:

gcig ni lung bstan dkar chag dang bcas pa mtsho rgyal gyis dbus ri nag po'i ltongs su phyi rabs kyi don du gsang gter du sbas: lha sras dam 'dzin la dus de nyid du dbang bskur lung byin: rjes su gnang ba gtad: ma 'ongs par lung bstan: u rgyan nyid: mnga' bdag rgyal po: mtsho rgyal lha sras dang bcas pa srin lag sbrel nas theg pa chen po'i zab chos dang 'phrad cing 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung bar smon lam btab: o rgyan gyis chos 'di nyid kyi dbang gi skabs su sprul pa byon par zhal gyis bzhes: byin rlabs mdzad par bka' nan gnang: mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid kyis kyang 'gro don kyi slad du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byon zhing: chos 'di la spyod cing 'gro ba la phan par smon lam mdzad: mtsho rgyal gyis kyang lha sras mgo 'don gyi tshul du byon nas: sems can thams cad kyi don byed par smon lam btab: lha sras kyi spyi bor phyag bzhag nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na gdul bya snod 283) dang ldan pa chos bdag nyer gcig: skyes bu brgya rtsa brgyad: rtsa ba'i bu bco lnga: mnga' bdag nyid dang bcas pa rnams la bka' gtad lung dang bcas pa sbyin par mdzad: dbang gi mtha' tshig byin nas mnga' gsol: zhal chab khar blugs pa la sogs mdzad cing: gzhan yi ge 'bru gcig kyang bri par ma gnang zhing bka' rgya mdzad do: zhes rgyal yum mtsho rgyal ma'i gsung las 'byung ba dang: 'gro don dus la babs pa'i tshul yang: pad+ma bka' thang las: gtsang gi skyer phu de ma gnyis kyi mtshams: rwa lag tshur lung phag pa khyu gcig 'byung: kong po 'phrang gsum sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas byung: o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes rdo rje'i lung don bzhin: lha sras 'bring po dam 'dzin mu rub bcad po'i rnam 'phrul gter ston grub thob yongs kyi spyi mes o rgyan 284) sangs rgyas gling pas pu ri phug mo che nas spyan drangs pa'i rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la:
sogs dang sbrel/ zhes pa'ang nye bar mkho bas rkyen byas te sangs rgyas gling pa'i sprul pa'i cha shas su lung thob pa pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
